learning_objective: Simplify a two-term ratio to its simplest integer form by dividing by the HCF.
title: Simplifying 18:24
stem: Simplify the ratio 18 : 24 to its simplest form.

solution_steps.description: Find the highest common factor of 18 and 24
solution_steps.permitted_scaffold_step: Divide both numbers by their common factor 6

solution_steps.description: Divide both parts by 6 to obtain simplest form

scaffold_probes.template: What is the greatest common factor of 18 and 24?

misconception_predictions.rationale: Student swapped antecedent and consequent terms.
Student divided by 2 but did not reduce to simplest terms.

isomorphic_worked_example.stem: Simplify the ratio 12 : 16 to its simplest form.

reasoning_options.label: Dividing both parts by their highest common factor 6

reflection.prompt_template: You found that {student_value}. What strategy helped you confirm this was simplest form?

options.label: Checked that 3 and 4 have no common factors other than 1
options.feedback: Spot on! When the only common factor is 1, the ratio is in simplest form.

options.label: Checked that 3 and 4 add up to 7
options.feedback: Adding the parts tells you the total shares, not if the terms are fully simplified.

options.label: Made sure both numbers were even
options.feedback: Notice that 3 is odd; terms do not need to be even to be simplified.
